_comment: Which MEP systems are one service, so a run of one ending on a run of another gets its tee, cross or reducer and the two are connected (Q6598). A service drawn as two layers or systems (a sprinkler main and its branch lines, a water main and its branches, a riser and its floor branches) is still one piping or duct service. Two systems are one service when they are the same kind (duct, pipe, conduit, tray, cable) and: pipes, what they carry (pipe_services.json) and the same circuit of it; ducts, the same duct type (supply, return, exhaust, outside air); otherwise (and for a pipe nothing names, or a service too broad to tie by), the same name once the words for a run's part in its service (`roles`) are left out. `roles`: whole words of the name (split at anything not a letter or digit, lower case). `circuits`: the circuits of a service that never connect to each other (the supply side is the circuit a name with none of these words is on): `contains` pieces of the lower-cased name, `words` whole words; the first that matches wins.
